question: A census of the image for static recompilation; the thread class behind one of its two CreateThread sites, read whole on the way.

addresses.name: WinThread::Start
addresses.comment: Slot 0 of WinThread's table (0x1208638, no RTTI). Does nothing unless +8 is 0. Boxes `this` in an 8-byte allocation (0x79602F) and calls CreateThread(0, 0, WinThread_ThreadProc 0x74F700, box, 0, this+4), the handle to +8; SetThreadPriority by +0x1C: 1 -> THREAD_PRIORITY_NORMAL, 2 -> ABOVE_NORMAL, anything else BELOW_NORMAL. A handle still 0 builds "Thread Creation failed!" and "winthread.cpp" and throws CThreadException (ThrowInfo 0x124B350) through _CxxThrowException. Has an EH frame. 0x74F500 to the bare `ret` at 0x74F65B. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-recomp.md, section 9.
addresses.evidence: The whole body on the install's bytes (capstone): the CreateThread argument pushes at 0x74F53B-0x74F548, the priority ladder at 0x74F550-0x74F567, the throw at 0x74F642 with the ThrowInfo's first catchable type `.?AVCThreadException@@`. The only reference to the entry is the table slot at 0x1208638.

addresses.name: WinThread::SetRunnable
addresses.comment: Slot 1 of WinThread's table: +0x18 = the argument, `ret 4`. The object stored is what WinThread::Run calls slot 1 of. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-recomp.md, section 9.
addresses.evidence: Five instructions read whole; referenced from the table at 0x120863C.

addresses.name: WinThread::Join
addresses.comment: Slot 2 of WinThread's table: WaitForSingleObject(+8, INFINITE), bare `ret`. Ghidra had made no function here. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-recomp.md, section 9.
addresses.evidence: Four instructions read whole at 0x74F670-0x74F67C; referenced from the table at 0x1208640.

addresses.name: WinThread::SetPriority
addresses.comment: Slot 3 of WinThread's table: SetThreadPriority(+8, priority), then +0x1C = priority - the raw Win32 value, where WinThread::Start reads +0x1C as 1 or 2. `ret 4`. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-recomp.md, section 9.
addresses.evidence: Read whole, 0x74F680 to the `ret 4` at 0x74F69B; referenced from the table at 0x1208644.

addresses.name: WinThread::IsRunning
addresses.comment: Slot 4 of WinThread's table: GetExitCodeThread(+8) and answers whether the code is STILL_ACTIVE (0x103). Bare `ret`. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-recomp.md, section 9.
addresses.evidence: Read whole, 0x74F6A0 to 0x74F6C1; referenced from the table at 0x1208648.

addresses.name: WinThread::Run
addresses.comment: Slot 5 of WinThread's table, which WinThread_ThreadProc tail-jumps to: answers 0 if GetCurrentThreadId equals +0xC (whose writer was not read), else calls slot 1 of the object at +0x18 and answers 1. Bare `ret` - so the thread procedure returns without popping its parameter. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-recomp.md, section 9.
addresses.evidence: Read whole, 0x74F6D0 to 0x74F6F2; referenced from the table at 0x120864C; the `mov edx, [eax+0x14]; jmp edx` in 0x74F700 is slot 5.

addresses.name: WinThread::~WinThread_scalar_deleting
addresses.comment: Slot 6 of WinThread's table: writes the table back (0x1208638), and if +8 holds a handle waits on it for +0x14 milliseconds - **a timeout calls ExitThread(0), ending the calling thread** - then CloseHandle; frees (0x795F9B) where bit 0 of the flags is set. `ret 4`. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-recomp.md, section 9.
addresses.evidence: Read whole, 0x74F4B0 to the `ret 4` at 0x74F4FA: the WAIT_TIMEOUT (0x102) compare at 0x74F4CE before `call ExitThread`; referenced from the table at 0x1208650.

addresses.name: WinThread_ThreadProc
addresses.comment: The routine WinThread::Start gives CreateThread: takes the WinThread out of the box, frees the box (0x795F9B), and tail-jumps to the object's slot 5, WinThread::Run, with this in ECX and its own parameter still on the stack - Run's bare `ret` leaves those 4 bytes for the kernel's frame to discard. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-recomp.md, section 9.
addresses.evidence: Seven instructions read whole, 0x74F700 to the `jmp edx` at 0x74F71B; its one reference is the push at 0x74F541 before CreateThread.

structs.name: WinThread
structs.comment: A thread class with no RTTI, from winthread.cpp by the strings its Start throws with; table at rva 0x1208638, seven slots. Size not read. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-recomp.md, section 9.
structs.evidence: The seven slot bodies, every field below read in them.

struct_fields.name: handle
struct_fields.comment: The thread's handle; Start runs only while it is 0. Waited on, closed, queried by the other slots.
struct_fields.evidence: mov [esi+8], eax after CreateThread at 0x74F553; read by Join, SetPriority, IsRunning and the destructor.

struct_fields.name: destroyWaitMs
struct_fields.comment: How long the destructor waits for the thread before calling ExitThread on its own.

struct_fields.name: runnable
struct_fields.comment: Set by SetRunnable; Run calls its slot 1.
struct_fields.evidence: 0x74F666 writes it; 0x74F6E2 reads it and calls [vftable+4].

struct_fields.name: priority
struct_fields.comment: Read by Start as 1 normal, 2 above normal, else below; written by SetPriority with the raw Win32 value.
